subject: Marketline pilot — technical fit & preferred demo window
messages:
From: Chris Taylor <chris.taylor@marketline.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo request and high-throughput use case

Hi Karthik,

I signed up for Redwood (self-serve) earlier this week and poked around the hosted API. We're evaluating Redwood for two things: a chat assistant embedded in our product and an embeddings-based semantic search index.

High level: we expect a pilot that will ramp to ~500k tokens/day and peak ~50 concurrent generation requests during the US business day. For search, we'll batch-embed ~2M docs initially (quarterly refresh).

Can we set up a short technical demo (30 min) with an SE to cover: model recommendations for cost/latency, batching/throughput best practices, and SSO/audit options? We prefer PST times. I'm attaching a traffic matrix + a short requirements doc.

Thanks —
Chris Taylor
CTO, Marketline
chris.taylor@marketline.io

Attachments: traffic_matrix.csv, marketline-poc-requirements.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Taylor <chris.taylor@marketline.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request and high-throughput use case

Hi Chris —

Thanks for the signup and the notes. I can absolutely get an SE on a short call. Quick follow-ups so we make the demo useful: 

- For the chat assistant: is generation mostly short replies (<= 40 tokens) or longer narratives (200+ tokens)?
- For embeddings: are you planning one-off bulk embeds (2M docs as you said) or continuous streaming updates?
- Latency SLO: what P50/P95 targets are you aiming for?
- Any restriction on hosted models (e.g., must be open checkpoints due to licensing) or requirement for Dedicated/Private infra?
- Timeline: pilot start target date?

If you prefer, Marissa can propose 3 windows next week (PST) and we'll match an SE accordingly.

I'll review the attachments and loop in Solutions.

—Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Chris Taylor <chris.taylor@marketline.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request and high-throughput use case

Karthik —

Answers inline:
- Chat: mostly short replies (30–80 tokens) but occasionally up to ~200 for context-heavy prompts.
- Embeddings: we'll do a one-off bulk of ~2M docs first, then incremental batches (couple of hundred thousand per month).
- Latency SLO: P95 <= 400ms for short generations, P95 <= 800ms acceptable for longer ones. For embeddings, faster is better but bulk-throughput matters more.
- Model constraints: prefer open models (we want transparent quantization/weights). If Dedicated is recommended for sustained throughput, we can discuss costs.
- Timeline: goal to start pilot mid-June (target kick-off week of 6/15).

Attached the traffic matrix and a one-page PoC doc. Happy to take the 30 min technical demo next Tue/Wed afternoon PST.

Thanks,
Chris
